mission: Mission 3DI - PopSign fresh5 post-scaffold strategy/downscope decision packet

head.subject: observer: ESCALATE - popsign fresh5 post scaffold strategy

scope.active_question: Choose one next route after M3DD-M3DH showed the motion-region-token scaffold collapsed before the classifier.

changed_files.change_summary: Tracked M3DI post-scaffold strategy/downscope decision receipt.
Numbered executor session log for the M3DI decision packet.

artifacts_inspected.role: M3DD bounded local scaffold fit/evaluation receipt

source_supported_observations.observation: M3DH completed the scaffold architecture/data generalization packet and selected fresh post-scaffold strategy escalation.
The single authorized scaffold fit failed to improve over prior chance-level PopSign fresh5 results.
M3DE-M3DG reduced common mechanical and last-layer explanations.
The route already consumed the prior observer-435/M3CX-M3CZ design chain and that chain produced the now-failed scaffold.

inference.inference: The recognition track is high risk for the school-project deadline under the current no-pretrained/no-upload/browser-first constraints.
inference.basis: Two materially different local recognition routes, including the post-strategy motion-region-token scaffold, collapsed to chance-level or nonseparable representations despite clean mechanical receipts.

inference.inference: One more design-only recognizer packet is unlikely to be the smallest useful next slice without human approval or materially new evidence.
inference.basis: M3CX-M3CZ already performed design-only strategy/contract work, M3DA-M3DG tested that design path, and observer 457 does not authorize implementation or training.

inference.inference: A fail-closed non-recognition learning MVP is the most useful next lane for preserving project value while avoiding unsupported ML claims.
inference.basis: The app can still deliver lessons, prompts, camera self-view, manual/self-assessment practice, progress UI, and evidence-preserving UX without claiming live ASL recognition.

unsupported_claims: Any current PopSign fresh5 recognizer is ready for browser activation.
A specific future architecture, dataset, optimizer, or Brev run will succeed.
The current evidence justifies pretrained CV/sign/landmark/model dependencies or generated pseudo-labels.
The current evidence justifies ASL correctness claims, final readiness, active labels, or a promoted model card.
The current packet approves public dataset import, source expansion, tensor mutation, or future compute spend.

ruled_out_explanations.explanation: total scaffold registration, diagnostic, tensor-shape, or forward-connectivity break
ruled_out_explanations.basis: M3DA shape/budget diagnostics and M3DB readiness confirmed B=1/B=2 no-grad forward, logits B,5, required diagnostic keys, and parameter/budget gates.

ruled_out_explanations.explanation: invocation/output guard as the remaining reason the scaffold could not be evaluated once
ruled_out_explanations.basis: M3DC repaired and dry-ran the exact smoke invocation/output guard path while preserving old-path compatibility.

ruled_out_explanations.explanation: single bounded scaffold fit succeeded or improved over prior baseline
ruled_out_explanations.basis: M3DD validation accuracy was 0.2 for every epoch, final train accuracy was 0.184, validation/test top1 were 0.2, macro F1 was 0.06666666666666668, and predictions collapsed to morning:125.
M3DE matched commands, hashes, selected checkpoint policy, and downstream threshold behavior; no epoch showed a local learning signal.

ruled_out_explanations.explanation: classifier bias or final classifier parameter state alone explains morning argmax
ruled_out_explanations.basis: M3DF found train/validation/test raw-logit collapse with classifier bias order pen > thank_you > who > home > morning, so morning had the lowest bias.
M3DG found nonseparable train representations before the final classifier and earlier token/pre-pool spaces also near chance.

ruled_out_explanations.explanation: current strategy memo chain is sufficient approval for another route
ruled_out_explanations.basis: Observer 435 and M3CX-M3CZ predate the M3DD-M3DG scaffold failure and led to the exact scaffold now shown to collapse before its classifier.

remaining_plausible_explanations.explanation: scratch architecture capacity or inductive-bias mismatch remains a primary plausible axis
remaining_plausible_explanations.basis: The revised motion-region-token scaffold materially differed from late fusion but still failed to learn label-separating representations across the balanced train split.

remaining_plausible_explanations.explanation: optimization/generalization limit under the current local recipe remains a primary plausible axis
remaining_plausible_explanations.basis: The scaffold was only allowed one bounded local recipe and still reproduced chance-level flat validation and train collapse; existing evidence ranks this but does not isolate it from architecture/input/data limits.

remaining_plausible_explanations.explanation: derived-motion/input representation signal sufficiency remains plausible
remaining_plausible_explanations.basis: The stored tensors and derived-motion contract are mechanically valid, but M3DG shows even pre-interaction token features do not provide usable class centroid separation under this model.

remaining_plausible_explanations.explanation: dataset size/diversity or single-source limitation remains plausible
remaining_plausible_explanations.basis: Prior split/source/tensor receipts reduce mechanical data defects but do not prove 25 clips per label per split from the current approved PopSign envelope are enough for a no-pretrained scratch recognizer.

remaining_plausible_explanations.explanation: label/source semantic quality beyond mechanical review remains possible but not the leading explanation
remaining_plausible_explanations.basis: M3CN cleared mechanical label/source slug consistency, but no external educator/regional-variant review is claimed. Uniform train representation collapse across all labels makes a single-label semantic issue insufficient as the main explanation.

evidence: M3DD scaffold fit stayed at validation/test top1 0.2 and macro F1 0.06666666666666668.
M3DF showed train/validation/test top1 collapsed to morning:125 and top2 to thank_you:125.
M3DG showed nonseparable train representation before the classifier, with post_norm nearest-centroid accuracy 0.216.
Prior M3CX-M3CZ design-only chain led to the failed scaffold rather than a validated route.
recognition_track_risk_assessment.risk_to_product_claims: live recognition or ASL correctness claims would be unsupported and potentially misleading
recognition_track_risk_assessment.risk_to_schedule: continuing recognizer-only loops risks spending the remaining school-project time without a usable learner-facing result
recognition_track_risk_assessment.risk_mitigation: redirect next work to a fail-closed non-recognition learning MVP while parking recognition until explicit human approval or materially new evidence exists

allowed_user_value: beginner vocabulary practice without live recognition claims
local camera self-view or recording-for-self-review only if privacy/fail-closed constraints remain explicit
manual/self-assessment checklists, progress tracking, and review workflows that do not imply ASL correctness evaluation
forbidden_claims: final readiness or active label support

product_downscope_options.reason: Human approval is required before reactivating recognition work, but pausing alone does not produce a useful project path. The receipt can redirect to a fail-closed MVP while preserving the same recognition approval boundary.
The recognition track should be parked in practice, but a product redirect gives the observer a constructive next prompt rather than only a stop state.

design_only_future_strategy_options.reason: Another design packet would repeat the pattern of M3CX-M3CZ unless a human approves a new scope, data/resource path, or research question. No code/training/compute route is authorized by this packet.
permitted_only_if_future_human_approval_: exact recognition scope and acceptable downscope boundary
data/source/legal plan or new approved first-party evidence
success/kill criteria and fail-closed claim boundary

notes: Observer 457 noted a running A100 workspace, but Mission 3DI does not authorize Brev spend, sync, teardown, lifecycle changes, or remote commands beyond optional read-only visibility.
Public ASL datasets remain research references unless exact source/legal review approves a specific use.
No raw learner video/frame upload path is authorized.

approval_topics: whether recognition is still required for the school-project submission
whether to accept a fail-closed non-recognition learning MVP
new source/data/legal path or first-party collection scope
Brev or other compute budget with max runtime/spend and kill/copyback/default-off rules
final claim, model-card, active-label, and browser activation policy
human_approval_needs.not_required_for_next_fail_closed_produc: A future prompt may draft/implement non-recognition learning flows only if it preserves fail-closed claims and avoids ASL correctness/recognition promises.

can_resume_only_if: human approves a new recognition strategy/resource path
new approved data/source/tensor evidence materially changes the failure landscape
a validated no-pretrained browser-viable artifact exists
a prompt explicitly records compute/source/architecture/final-claim approvals and boundaries
stop_or_parking_conditions.full_stop_not_selected_now: Product work can continue as a fail-closed learning MVP without live recognition claims.

decision.rationale: The current recognizer lane has exhausted the useful no-training local diagnostic/design loop: the prior strategy/design chain produced a scaffold that still collapsed before the classifier, and no prompt authorizes training, Brev, source/data mutation, implementation, export, or recognition claims. The best school-project route is to redirect executor effort to a fail-closed learning MVP with no live recognition or ASL correctness claims while parking recognition until explicit human approval or materially new approved evidence exists.

negative_authorizations_reaffirmed.proof: This packet used only local read-only docs, receipts, strategy artifacts, claim surfaces, hashes, and JSON validation. The only intended tracked changes are this receipt and session log 458.
